siteContent.hero_title: A trusted digital home for your madarsa community
siteContent.hero_description: Share your mission, manage admissions, organize classes, and let teachers record daily attendance from one place.
siteContent.about_text: Madarsa Islamia Darul Huda is dedicated to nurturing Quranic learning, strong character, and a disciplined love for sacred knowledge in a well-organized environment.
siteContent.admission_text: Families can submit admission details online. The head of the madarsa can review students, assign courses, and manage progress through the admin section.
siteContent.footer_text: Madarsa Islamia Darul Huda. Serving students with sincerity and structure.
